title: Binary matroid representation of cyclic families

statement.text: Let <math>B=\{b_1,b_2,\ldots ,b_k\}\subset\{0,1,\ldots ,n-1\}</math>, and let <math>B_i=\{b_1+i, b_2+i,\ldots, b_k+i\}</math> where addition is modulo ''n''. That is, <math>{\mathcal B}=\{B_1,B_2,\ldots B_N\}</math> is the collection of ''cyclic translates'' of ''B''. Prove that there exists a binary matroid ''M'' such that every <math>B_i</math> is a basis of ''M''.
